name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (2011)
quirks: The original 2011 release; most new mods target Special Edition.

Luma keeps plugins.txt in step with your mods while they're in the game: plugins (.esp/.esm/.esl) of enabled mods are turned on, masters first, in your mod order. Turn single plugins off under Plugins. loadorder.txt is written too.
